design.split_rule: val_end <= test_start - H; at run time val_end is clamped to test_start - H if needed
design.selection: fixed split: choose by validation WAPE, report on test
design.scoring: h=3 forecast window; only target months with m+label_lag <= pull_as_of are scored
design.tsb_init: z0=nonzero fraction, d0=mean of nonzero demands over full training history, then smooth; d unchanged on zeros

label_overlap_check.definition: label for month m available at m+label_lag (first day); decision for origin t at t+label_lag (first day)

data_quality.gate: row kept in raw with qty blank + qty_status=bad; any bad row marks the SKU-month bad_data and excludes it from training/evaluation; never converted to 0
data_quality.source_rows_note: source_rows = sheet row_count including header; extracted_rows = aligned data rows read (row 2..N). A successful sheet read does not prove all cross-month shipment rows exist; counts are logged per month for audit.
data_quality.completeness_caveat: 月表读取成功 ≠ 跨月发货行完整；本实验不声称数据完整，仅逐月记录 source_rows/extracted_rows/blank_tail 供核对。
